The remaining second derivatives are:

$$
\begin{aligned}
\frac{\partial^2 \llik}{\partial (\varpar)^2}
&= \deriv{\varpar}\paren{-\frac{n}{2}\paren{\varpar}^{-1}
 + \frac{1}{2}\paren{\varpar}^{-2}\sumin (x_i - \mean)^2}
&& \text{(differentiate the score for $\varpar$)}\\
&= \deriv{\varpar}\paren{-\frac{n}{2}\paren{\varpar}^{-1}}
 + \deriv{\varpar}\paren{\frac{1}{2}\paren{\varpar}^{-2}\sumin (x_i - \mean)^2}
&& \text{(linearity of differentiation)}\\
&= \deriv{\varpar}\paren{-\frac{n}{2}\paren{\varpar}^{-1}}
 + \deriv{\varpar}\paren{\frac{1}{2}\sumin (x_i - \mean)^2 \paren{\varpar}^{-2}}
&& \text{(reorder the factors)}\\
&= -\frac{n}{2}\deriv{\varpar}\paren{\varpar}^{-1}
 + \frac{1}{2}\sumin (x_i - \mean)^2 \deriv{\varpar}\paren{\varpar}^{-2}
&& \text{(constant multiple rule)}\\
&= -\frac{n}{2}\paren{-\paren{\varpar}^{-2}}
 + \frac{1}{2}\sumin (x_i - \mean)^2 \deriv{\varpar}\paren{\varpar}^{-2}
&& \text{(power rule for $v^{-1}$)}\\
&= -\frac{n}{2}\paren{-\paren{\varpar}^{-2}}
 + \frac{1}{2}\sumin (x_i - \mean)^2 \paren{-2\paren{\varpar}^{-3}}
&& \text{(power rule for $v^{-2}$)}\\
&= \frac{n}{2}\paren{\varpar}^{-2} - \sumin (x_i - \mean)^2 \paren{\varpar}^{-3}
&& \text{(multiply the constants)}\\
&= \frac{n}{2}\paren{\varpar}^{-2} - \paren{\varpar}^{-3}\sumin (x_i - \mean)^2
&& \text{(reorder the factors)}\\
\frac{\partial^2 \llik}{\partial \mean \, \partial \varpar}
&= \deriv{\mean}\paren{-\frac{n}{2}\paren{\varpar}^{-1}
 + \frac{1}{2}\paren{\varpar}^{-2}\sumin (x_i - \mean)^2}
&& \text{(differentiate the score for $\varpar$)}\\
&= \deriv{\mean}\paren{-\frac{n}{2}\paren{\varpar}^{-1}}
 + \deriv{\mean}\paren{\frac{1}{2}\paren{\varpar}^{-2}\sumin (x_i - \mean)^2}
&& \text{(linearity of differentiation)}\\
&= 0 + \deriv{\mean}\paren{\frac{1}{2}\paren{\varpar}^{-2}\sumin (x_i - \mean)^2}
&& \text{(derivative of a constant)}\\
&= \deriv{\mean}\paren{\frac{1}{2}\paren{\varpar}^{-2}\sumin (x_i - \mean)^2}
&& \text{(drop the zero term)}\\
&= \frac{1}{2}\paren{\varpar}^{-2}\deriv{\mean}\sumin (x_i - \mean)^2
&& \text{(constant multiple rule)}\\
&= \frac{1}{2}\paren{\varpar}^{-2}\sumin \deriv{\mean}(x_i - \mean)^2
&& \text{(derivative of a sum is the sum of derivatives)}\\
&= \frac{1}{2}\paren{\varpar}^{-2}\sumin -2(x_i - \mean)
&& \text{(chain-rule result from the score for $\mean$)}\\
&= \frac{1}{2}\paren{\varpar}^{-2} \cdot (-2) \sumin (x_i - \mean)
&& \text{(factor the constant $-2$ out of the sum)}\\
&= -\paren{\varpar}^{-2}\sumin (x_i - \mean)
&& \text{(multiply the constants)}
\end{aligned}
$$

At the MLE, $\sumin (x_i - \bar x) = 0$
and $\sumin (x_i - \bar x)^2 = n\hvarpar$
(writing $\hvarpar$ for $\hvarpar_{\text{ML}}$), so:

$$
\begin{aligned}
\evalAt{\frac{\partial^2 \llik}{\partial (\varpar)^2}}{\text{MLE}}
&= \frac{n}{2}\paren{\hvarpar}^{-2} - \paren{\hvarpar}^{-3}\sumin (x_i - \bar x)^2
&& \text{(evaluate at $\mean = \bar x$, $\varpar = \hvarpar$)}\\
&= \frac{n}{2}\paren{\hvarpar}^{-2} - \paren{\hvarpar}^{-3} n\hvarpar
&& \text{(substitute $\textstyle\sumin (x_i - \bar x)^2 = n\hvarpar$)}\\
&= \frac{n}{2}\paren{\hvarpar}^{-2} - n\paren{\hvarpar}^{-3}\hvarpar
&& \text{(reorder the factors)}\\
&= \frac{n}{2}\paren{\hvarpar}^{-2} - n\paren{\hvarpar}^{-2}
&& \text{(cancel one factor of $\hvarpar$)}\\
&= -\frac{n}{2}\paren{\hvarpar}^{-2}
&& \text{(combine like terms)}\\
\evalAt{\frac{\partial^2 \llik}{\partial \mean \, \partial \varpar}}{\text{MLE}}
&= -\paren{\hvarpar}^{-2}\sumin (x_i - \bar x)
&& \text{(evaluate at $\mean = \bar x$, $\varpar = \hvarpar$)}\\
&= -\paren{\hvarpar}^{-2} \cdot 0
&& \text{(substitute $\textstyle\sumin (x_i - \bar x) = 0$)}\\
&= 0
&& \text{(multiply by zero)}
\end{aligned}
$$
